Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; reviewed period printings; issue #738.

Cards.Name: A Dangerous Game
Cards.Text: You may discard your hand (even if it is empty). If you did, draw four cards.

Cards.Name: An Empire of Madness
Cards.Text: Until the game ends, each player has the ability, "Open: Your target Personality with a Madness token commits Seppuku" and any player who ends his turn with 20 or more Madness tokens on his Personalities loses the game.

Cards.Name: Journey's End Siege
Cards.Text: Limited: Defending players may not play Terrains (this turn). After the first time you destroy a Province in battle this turn, if you do not have more Provinces than the Defender (at that time), gain a Province.

Cards.Name: Open Recruitment
Cards.Text: Until your Events Phase two turns from now begins, after each time an unaligned Human Personality turns face-up in one of your provinces, permanently give him your Clan alignment. He has sworn fealty to you.

Cards.Name: Rejected Mediation
Cards.Text: Any player who controls the Imperial Favor discards it. Until your second turn from now begins, negate the effects of the first Political action taken each turn.

Cards.Name: The Jade Championship
Cards.Text: Choose one of your Shugenja in play. Permanently give him the traits, "Shadowlands Personalities and Followers have -1F while at this Personality's location" and "After the resolution of an action from a Spell: Straighten this Personality."

Cards.Name: The Madness Spreads
Cards.Text: Limited: Until your second turn from now begins, once per turn, you may take a Limited action on a Strategy as an Open action.
